title: Node power anomaly on r10n4 (total_power ~1400W)
summary: IPMI total_power on r10n4 spiked to ~1400W, sustained for ~30 minutes, versus a ~644W rack-10 baseline (~117% over baseline). Power-supply input (ps0_input_power, ps1_input_power) rose to ~740W each.
notes: Correlate with job 7558120 (cfd_solver). Consider per-node power cap.
